# ANALYSIS: Stage-1 Backtest on J Anchor Days

**Filed:** 2026-07-21
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** analysis
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We need to compute edge_capture, aggregate Sharpe, walk-forward OOS ratio, and real-fills validation on the J anchor days (winners: 4/29, 5/01, 5/04; losers: 5/05, 5/06, 5/07) via a Stage-1 backtest to quantify the engine's performance on the source-of-truth trades.

## Mechanism

Run the autoresearch grinder on the J anchor days to capture engine P&L on each day. Compute edge_capture = sum(engine_pnl_on_winners) - sum(max(0, engine_loss_on_losers)). Compute aggregate Sharpe over the OOS window, walk-forward OOS ratio, and validate real-fills on the top-3 J days (4/29, 5/01, 5/04) by comparing BS-sim vs realistic OPRA fills.
